ModMetaData.name: RimMandrake: Utinni - Waste Run
ModMetaData.author: mandrake
ModMetaData.description: WARCASKET_WASTE_RUN_REMAINDER_1. The gravship waste run: ONE quest (RUT_WasteRun), offered once a cask bay holds waste, where the destination you choose is the branch. v1 destinations: drop it on the Empire (goodwill collapse), freeze it on the cold side, entomb it on the Assailants, sink it in the propane lakes (records the ignition; the war-lab breach is a stub until ANCIENT_WAR_LAB_1), and the Slime experiment (outcome rolled at quest generation; world effects stubbed). The half-extracted core is only waste to dispose of. All numbers PROVISIONAL. Mod Settings toggle the master switch, the offer and each destination.
